name: netnavr-shell
description: A macOS-first interaction shell for the NetNavr local runtime.
author: The NetNavr Authors

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @netnavr/shell-server && npm run build -w @netnavr/shell-web && npm run build -w @netnavr/shell-desktop
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @netnavr/shell-protocol && npm run build -w @netnavr/shell-model-router && npm run build -w @netnavr/shell-codex-client
scripts.precheck: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @netnavr/shell-server
scripts.check: npm run check -w @netnavr/shell-protocol && npm run check -w @netnavr/shell-model-router && npm run check -w @netnavr/shell-codex-client && npm run check -w @netnavr/shell-server && npm run check -w @netnavr/shell-web && npm run check -w @netnavr/shell-desktop
scripts.dev:mac: npm run build && npm run start -w @netnavr/shell-desktop
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @netnavr/shell-server
scripts.start:mac: npm run build && npm run start -w @netnavr/shell-desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @netnavr/shell-server && npm run test -w @netnavr/shell-web && npm run test -w @netnavr/shell-desktop
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:integration
